app_name: Yash Wealth & Construction Finance Command Center
app_context: High-net-worth personal wealth dashboard & multi-partner construction project finance tracker for Yash. Features AUD base currency, live multi-currency FX (USD/AUD/INR), partner cost sharing (Yash, Sanjay, Pranay, Max), loan drawdowns, property portfolio tracking, and pairwise settle-up ledger.
design_archetype: Architectural Precision & High-Net-Worth Calm (Swiss High-Contrast meets Warm Architectural Slate)
theme_strategy: Light/Dark mode switchable. Light Mode: Clean warm bone background (#F8F9FA) with sharp slate borders and emerald/gold accents. Dark Mode: Deep Obsidian (#0B0F17) background with muted zinc cards (#111827), subtle 1px borders, and high-visibility financial data density.

font_rules.h1: font-heading font-extrabold text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight text-foreground
font_rules.h2: font-heading font-bold text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight text-foreground
font_rules.label_overline: font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground

layout_and_spacing.card_style: rounded-xl border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-slate-400/40 dark:hover:border-slate-700/60
layout_and_spacing.glass_header: sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border shadow-xs

feature_implementations.1_auth: Simple login view (email + password) with pre-filled demo trigger for Yash (yash@wealth.app) and quick state bypass for effortless reviewer access.
feature_implementations.2_net_worth_dashboard: Total Net Worth in AUD combining Cash + Shares + Term Insurance + Properties + Project Equity - Total Debt. Includes live AUD/USD/INR FX rates ticker, historical net worth trend chart (Recharts), breakdown by asset class, and fast currency switcher toggle.
feature_implementations.3_construction_projects: Multi-project tracker cards (e.g. 'South Yarra Luxury Apartments', 'Brighton Townhouses Phase II', 'Docklands Commercial Hub') showing completion %, total budget, Yash's share %, cash contributed to date, loan drawdowns, and quick action tabs.
feature_implementations.4_project_detail_views: Two distinct views per project: (A) Overall Project View with all partners, combined budget, costs, loans; (B) 4-Partner View for Yash, Sanjay, Pranay, and Max with ownership percentages, individual capital calls, and total equity stakes.
feature_implementations.5_partner_money_ledger: Money management tracker for Yash, Sanjay, Pranay, Max. Handles 'paid on behalf of partner X', per-project pairwise balances ('Who owes whom'), individual transactions (Pay/Take), settlement calculator, and printable/shareable PDF-style report modal.
feature_implementations.6_personal_investments: Multi-currency portfolio tracker for Shares (USD/AUD/INR), Term Insurance, and Other Investments. Real-time conversion to AUD base currency using auto-fetched or live simulated FX rates API.
feature_implementations.7_cost_cash_tracker: Per-project cost breakdown by categories (Site Acquisition, Architectural & Permits, Foundation & Structure, MEP & Finishes, Marketing/Legal). Tracks paid vs committed cash flow.
feature_implementations.8_loan_drawdown_tracker: Per-project debt & facility tracker. Visualizes total facility, drawn amount, remaining drawdown limit, amortizing vs interest-only repayments, interest rate (%), and interactive repayment schedule table.
feature_implementations.9_pairwise_ledger_report: Dedicated pairwise matrix report showing net balance between every partner pair (e.g. Yash <-> Sanjay, Yash <-> Max) with transaction audit trail and export/share capabilities.
feature_implementations.10_property_portfolio: Personal investment properties overview showing current rental yield, monthly rent (AUD), purchase date, initial cost, current estimated value, and attached property mortgages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load JetBrains Mono, Outfit, and Inter fonts in index.html / index.css.
Ensure dark/light theme toggle works smoothly across all pages with next-themes or state-based dark class toggle on documentElement.
Base currency MUST default to AUD throughout the app, with AUD/USD/INR FX rates clearly displayed and auto-updating or refreshable.
All financial figures MUST use JetBrains Mono or tabular-nums for crisp vertical alignment.
Partner Ledger must clearly identify the 4 partners: Yash, Sanjay, Pranay, Max, and perform automated pairwise matrix calculation (Yash owes Sanjay $X, Max owes Yash $Y).
Add detailed data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, selects) for testing automation.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when transactions or updates are saved.
Ensure all modals (Add Transaction, Add Drawdown, Settle Up, Add Property) are rich, well-styled, and functional.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_quality: Avoid plain AI slop. Use structured bento cards, crisp 1px borders, subtle hover transitions, and rich data density.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: High contrast APCA standard readability in both dark and light modes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_ids: Every key button, input, tab, card, and metric container MUST include data-testid='...' in kebab-case.
